newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FPHC unit eyes 100.5 mln peso expansion.
newsitem.headline: FPHC unit eyes 100.5 mln peso expansion.

text.p: Philippine Electric Corp (Philec), a subsidiary of First Philippine Holdings Corp, is planning to expand and modernise its manufacturing plant, documents submitted to the Board of Investments on Friday showed.
Philec plan to invest 54.2 million pesos for the rehabilitation and upgrading of its existing facility and 46.3 million pesos for the acquisition of new machines and equipment.
The company is manufacturing power transformers and distribution transformers for local industries, power cooperatives and utility firms.
Philec proposed to increase its capacity by 72 percent to 263,000 kilovolt-amperes for power transformers and by 47 percent to 1.2 million kva for distribution transformers.
